text:
Molly H: Quick heads-up — we need to schedule the PIR for the payment-timeout incident. Looking for a facilitator and to lock attendees.
Sanjay K: I can facilitate if nobody else is up for it. availability: Tue 10–11am or Wed 4–5pm PT.
Jamie L: Tue morning clobbers my APAC day, Wed 4pm PT is ok for me.
Rachael P: I can co-facilitate or take notes. Preference: Wed 4pm PT (works with CS lead).
devops-bot: Incident #2024-11-08-PAY-TMO summary: paging at 02:12 UTC, degraded checkout for ~27m, mitigation applied 02:40 UTC, customer impact high. Logs + traces: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2024-11-08/pay-tmo
Molly H: Good context. Required attendees: SRE oncall, payments eng lead, payments PM, CS oncall (for customer impact), infra lead (brief), and the person who ran the mitigation (David).
Sanjay K: I can run the session but will need someone from CS to confirm customer impact notes. Rachael willing to take notes so I'll lead.
Jamie L: Can we keep it 45m? Agenda: timeline, root-cause hypothesis, actions + owners, rollout/QA followups.
Rachael P: Agreed. I'll assemble a 1-pager pre-read. Will include timeline + top-5 logs + mitigation snippet.
Molly H: Perfect. Two scheduling asks: 1) confirm Wed 4pm PT works for David (mitigation owner) and CS lead; 2) add timezone-friendly dial-in (video + recording).
pagerbot: Pager duty: David T is currently acknowledged on the payment policy rotation. David T: I can do Wed 4pm PT, but prefer start +5 to allow handover (can join at 4:05).
Molly H: Noted. We'll start 4:05 then. Rachael — can you own the calendar invite and add the pre-read? Put the invite out with "PIR: payment timeout — short pre-read attached" and set a 45m slot.
Rachael P: Will do. Pre-read checklist (draft):
```
- Short timeline (who/when)
- Customer impact summary (CS)
- Mitigation steps taken + command snippets
- Quick perf/latency graphs (last 60m)
- Open questions for RCA
```
Rachael P: I'll ping CS for impact notes and attach logs. Expect invite in 20m.
Sanjay K: Action items I can own: run the timeline section and proposed mitigation improvements.
Jamie L: I'll handle the rollout/QA followups item.
Molly H: Adding owners: 
- Timeline & mitigation improvements: Sanjay K
- Rollout & QA: Jamie L
- Notes & pre-read: Rachael P
- Customer impact summary: CS lead (Emma) — @Emma can you confirm?
Emma: (joined thread) Confirmed, I'll add the customer-impact bullets to Rachael's pre-read and join Wed 4:05 PT.
Molly H: Thanks. One more ops ask: if we propose a config guardrail change, let's include bench results. Sanjay, can you try to include a brief perf snapshot?
Sanjay K: Yep — I'll add a 1-slide perf snapshot to the pre-read.
Rachael P: Invite sent: Wed 4:05–4:50pm PT, link + recording enabled. Attached pre-read v0.1.
Molly H: Awesome. Final check — any other must-attend folks?
Jamie L: Security doesn't need to be in unless we see auth issues.
Molly H: Okay. Marking attendees: SRE oncall, payments eng lead, payments PM, CS lead (Emma), infra lead, David T, Sanjay K (facilitator), Rachael P (recorder), Jamie L.
Rachael P: I'll add the action tracker to the invite and create a follow-up Trello card for long-term items.
Molly H: Thank you. If no objections, we'll treat this as confirmed. :thumbsup:
Sanjay K: :thumbsup:
Emma: :thumbsup:
David T: joining at 4:05 — thanks for the slack ping.
Molly H: Closing — reminder: bring any query IDs you used for triage so we can link traces in the doc.
Rachael P: noted, will add a "what to bring" bullet in the invite.
Molly H: Great. Closing thread.
